source: JLCPCB parts library page https://jlcpcb.com/partdetail/C2862588 read 2026-11-11 (Texas Instruments TLV7022DDFR, package TSOT-23-8, library type Extended) ; LCSC product record for C2862588 (the data behind https://www.lcsc.com/product-detail/C2862588.html, fetched from wmsc.lcsc.com/ftps/wm/product/detail?productCode=C2862588) read 2026-11-11 (TI TLV7022DDFR, TSOT-23-8, dual comparator, open-drain output, 1.6 V to 5.5 V single supply, 5 uA, 260 ns; listed stock 767) ; datasheet: TI TLV7011, TLV7021, TLV7012, TLV7022, ZHCSGK4E (Chinese edition, September 2017, revised November 2019; the PDF of https://datasheet.lcsc.com/datasheet/pdf/d955c7471084950f84e5242f5ec7a175.pdf, 50 pages, SHA-256 d42843468456): page 4 section 5 the pin functions of the TLV7012/22; page 6 Table 6.5 Recommended Operating Conditions (Dual): supply 1.6 V to 6.5 V, ambient -40 C to 125 C; PDF page 27 the orderable addendum (TLV7022DDFR, SOT-23-THIN, DDF, 8 leads); PDF pages 34 to 36 the DDF0008A package outline (1.1 mm max height), example board layout and stencil ; the number is the LCSC property of U4 of the charger module's board file (reference/charger-module.kicad_pcb)
notes: Texas Instruments TLV7022, dual comparator with open-drain outputs (TLV702x), and no internal reference (the task of a reference is done by the board's resistor dividers). JLCPCB and LCSC name the package TSOT-23-8; the datasheet calls it SOT-23-THIN, DDF, 8 leads. The pin table is the datasheet's TLV7012/22 table, which is drawn for the VSSOP-8 (DGK) package: the datasheet prints no DDF pinout and the DDF numbering is taken to be the same (the reference board's nets are consistent with it). The datasheet read is the Chinese edition (numbers and figures as the English one). height is the DDF0008A maximum. temp_min and temp_max are the recommended ambient range. Price not recorded.
